news.headline: Caribou Biosciences, Inc. (NasdaqGS:CRBU) added to Russell 2000 Index
news.summary: Caribou Biosciences was added to the Russell 2000 Index (and related Russell benchmarks) as part of FTSE Russell's June 2026 semi-annual US indexes reconstitution, effective after markets closed June 26, 2026, broadening the stock's institutional and passive-fund investor base.

news.headline: Caribou Biosciences to Participate in the H.C. Wainwright 4th Annual Cell Therapy Virtual Conference
news.summary: CEO Rachel Haurwitz participated in a fireside chat at the H.C. Wainwright 4th Annual Cell Therapy Virtual Conference on June 30, 2026, discussing the company's allogeneic CAR-T pipeline.

news.headline: Caribou Biosciences holders vote on 2026 proposals (Annual Meeting 8-K)
news.summary: At its annual stockholder meeting on June 17, 2026, Caribou shareholders elected three Class II directors and ratified Deloitte & Touche LLP as the company's independent registered public accounting firm for fiscal year 2026.

news.headline: Caribou Biosciences Reports Dose Escalation Durability Data for CB-011 at the 2026 European Hematology Association (EHA) Annual Meeting
news.summary: Updated CaMMouflage Phase 1 data in 12 BCMA-naive relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma patients treated with CB-011 at the recommended dose showed a 92% overall response rate, 83% complete/stringent complete response rate, 91% MRD-negativity, and 50% still in CR or better at 15 months; Caribou guided to initial dose-expansion data for CB-011 in the second half of 2026.

news.headline: Caribou Biosciences Reports Long-Term Vispa-cel Data in Second-line Large B Cell Lymphoma at EHA 2026
news.summary: Long-term ANTLER Phase 1 follow-up data presented at EHA 2026 showed vispa-cel (CB-010), an off-the-shelf CD19-targeted allogeneic CAR-T, producing deep and durable responses in second-line large B-cell lymphoma on par with autologous CAR-T therapies.

catalysts.label: Q2 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Caribou is expected to report second-quarter 2026 financial results and provide a pipeline business update around early-to-mid August 2026; the exact date has not yet been formally confirmed by the company.

catalysts.label: CB-011 dose-expansion data (CaMMouflage trial)
catalysts.detail: Caribou has guided to initial data from the dose-expansion portion of the CaMMouflage Phase 1 trial evaluating CB-011 in relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma in the second half of 2026.

catalysts.label: Vispa-cel (CB-010) pivotal ANTLER-3 trial start-up
catalysts.detail: Following FDA alignment on the pivotal ANTLER-3 trial design for vispa-cel in second-line LBCL, Caribou is conducting start-up activities while exploring options to fully fund the pivotal trial; cash runway is guided into 2H 2027.

pulse: Caribou enters late July 2026 on clinical momentum: EHA 2026 data showed CB-011 delivering an 83% complete-response rate with 91% MRD-negativity in BCMA-naive myeloma patients, while vispa-cel (CB-010) continued to show durable, autologous-CAR-T-like responses in second-line lymphoma, reinforcing its March 2026 FDA RMAT designation. Late June brought a Russell 2000 Index addition, widening the shareholder base, even as management continues exploring funding options for the planned vispa-cel pivotal trial (cash runway guided into 2H 2027). Investor focus now shifts to Q2 2026 earnings (expected around mid-August) and CB-011 dose-expansion data due later this year.
